title: Figures 6-7: Casimir segmented tunnels and strip/spacer-channel apparatus renderings
description: Two computer renderings of proposed apparatus: left, a cutaway yellow block containing a dense grid of fine tunnels; right, an angled view of alternating yellow and dark strips with spacer channels. Captions: "Figure 6. Apparatus for Ground State Energy Suppression: Casimir Segmented Tunnels" and "Figure 7. Alternative Apparatus for Ground State Energy Suppression: Casimir Strip and Spacer-Channels." Text below discusses microcavity fabrication and an H2 gas experiment at the Synchrotron Radiation Center, University of Wisconsin at Madison.
